story:
SETS (make each one a cast member of kind "set" and give every shot the set of the place it shows):
1. The engawa veranda of grandma's Kyoto machiya with shoji and a small garden (kit place: veranda); summer day and night
2. The Gion festival street lined with lantern-lit stalls (kit place: market); dusk
3. Grandma's tatami room with a low table (kit place: tea-room); night

夏休み、ゆいは、京都のおばあちゃんの家に、遊びに来ました。縁側には、古い江戸風鈴が、ひとつ下がっていますが、もう、音が鳴りません。「おじいちゃんと買った風鈴なの」と、おばあちゃんは、言いました。夕方、二人は、浴衣を着て、祇園祭の宵山へ、出かけました。提灯の灯る通りには、屋台が、ずらりと並んでいます。風鈴の屋台で、ゆいは、青い短冊を、一枚選びました。夜、家に帰ると、ゆいは、短冊に、願いごとを書きました。「おばあちゃんの風鈴が、また、鳴りますように」。ゆいが、短冊を風鈴に結ぶと、夜風が、そっと吹きました。ちりん。風鈴が、ひさしぶりに、鳴りました。おばあちゃんは、そっと涙をふいて、ゆいの頭を、なでました。

bible.title: 風鈴の願い
bible.logline: 夏休み、京都の町家で祖母と過ごす少女が、祇園祭の夜に青い短冊を風鈴に結び、静かな奇跡を呼び起こす。

cast.name: Engawa Veranda
cast.look: Traditional Kyoto machiya engawa veranda with sliding shoji doors opening onto a small mossy garden, wooden floor, low wooden railing, summer daylight filtering through bamboo blinds.

cast.name: Gion Festival Street
cast.look: Gion festival street at dusk, lined with wooden stalls hung with glowing paper lanterns, cobblestone pavement, crowds suggested by silhouettes.

cast.name: Tatami Tea Room
cast.look: Tatami tea-room with low lacquered table, shoji screen to garden, soft night light from paper lantern outside.

cast.name: Yui
cast.look: Small 7-year-old girl with short black bob, wearing a light cotton yukata with pale floral pattern, barefoot on veranda, later in an indigo yukata at festival.

cast.name: Grandma
cast.look: Elderly woman with gentle wrinkles, silver hair tied back, wearing a simple indigo kimono with white obi, warm smile.

cast.name: Edo Wind Chime
cast.look: Old Edo-style brass wind chime hanging from veranda eaves, four slender rods with paper strips, initially silent.

states.look: brass chime hanging still, paper strips limp
brass chime swaying gently, paper strips fluttering, faint chime sound

cast.name: Blue Tanzaku Strip
cast.look: Blue rectangular tanzaku paper strip, smooth, about 10cm long, tied with thin red thread.

states.look: blue strip tied to wind chime's lower rod, fluttering in breeze

shots.description: Wide shot of the engawa veranda in bright summer morning, shoji doors open onto a green garden; Yui steps onto the wooden floor, Grandma watches from the doorway. Morning, bright sunlight.
shots.dialogue: 夏休み、ゆいは、京都のおばあちゃんの家に、遊びに来ました。

shots.description: Medium shot framing the old Edo wind chime hanging from the veranda eaves, its paper strips motionless in the still air; the garden beyond is quiet. Midday, bright sun.
shots.dialogue: 縁側には、古い江戸風鈴が、ひとつ下がっていますが、もう、音が鳴りません。

shots.description: Close-up of Grandma's kindly face as she gestures to the chime, soft light catching her eyes; she explains it was bought with Grandpa. Midday, gentle light.
shots.dialogue: 「おじいちゃんと買った風鈴なの」と、おばあちゃんは、言いました。

shots.description: Wide shot of the Gion festival street at dusk, lanterns glowing amber along stalls; Yui and Grandma in yukata walk side by side into the bustling lane. Dusk, lantern glow.
shots.dialogue: 夕方、二人は、浴衣を着て、祇園祭の宵山へ、出かけました。

shots.description: Medium shot panning along the lantern-lit stalls, paper lanterns swaying gently in the evening breeze, crowds suggested by silhouettes. Dusk, lantern glow.
shots.dialogue: 提灯の灯る通りには、屋台が、ずらりと並んでいます。

shots.description: Close-up of Yui's hand picking a blue tanzaku strip from a stall's display, the paper's cool hue vivid against warm lantern light. Dusk, lantern glow.
shots.dialogue: 風鈴の屋台で、ゆいは、青い短冊を、一枚選びました。

shots.description: Medium shot inside the tatami tea-room at night, low table illuminated by a single paper lantern; Yui sits writing on the blue tanzaku, Grandma watches nearby. Night, lantern glow.
shots.dialogue: 夜、家に帰ると、ゆいは、短冊に、願いごとを書きました。

shots.description: Close-up of the blue tanzaku now bearing the handwritten wish in delicate brush strokes, the characters glowing faintly in the dim light. Night, lantern glow.
shots.dialogue: 「おばあちゃんの風鈴が、また、鳴りますように」。

shots.description: Medium shot over Yui's shoulder on the veranda at night, she ties the blue tanzaku to the wind chime's lower rod; a gentle night breeze stirs the garden leaves. Night, soft breeze.
shots.dialogue: ゆいが、短冊を風鈴に結ぶと、夜風が、そっと吹きました。

shots.description: Close-up of the wind chime as the night wind sets it swaying, the brass rods chiming softly 'chirin', paper strips fluttering. Night, breeze.
shots.dialogue: ちりん。風鈴が、ひさしぶりに、鳴りました。

shots.description: Wide shot of the veranda under starry night, Grandma gently wipes a tear and strokes Yui's head, the wind chime's faint tone lingering. Night, starlight.
shots.dialogue: おばあちゃんは、そっと涙をふいて、ゆいの頭を、なでました。
